# ZCode

Validates Z.ai ZCode project configuration and plugin packages against ZCode's open-source loader. Project rules check subagent frontmatter in `.zcode/agents/*.md` and the `hooks` and `mcp` sections of `.zcode/config.json`, where a single misplaced hooks key makes ZCode discard the whole file. Plugin rules check `.zcode-plugin/plugin.json` manifests, the hooks a ZCode-only plugin ships (ZCode runs seven events and `command`/`process` handlers), and the root `marketplace.json` catalog of a ZCode marketplace.

ZCode reads AGENTS.md for instructions, Agent Skills from `.zcode/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, and commands from `.zcode/commands/`, all of which receive skillsaw's shared content and security checks.

A plugin that ships both `.zcode-plugin/` and `.claude-plugin/` manifests keeps its Claude Code results: Claude reads the shared `hooks/hooks.json` and `.mcp.json` too.

The rules enable on three separate conditions. Project rules need a `.zcode/` directory holding `skills/`, `commands/`, `agents/`, `workflows/` or `config.json`. Plugin rules need a `.zcode-plugin/plugin.json`. Marketplace rules also need a repository-root `marketplace.json` and no `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.

| Rule ID | Description | Default Severity | Autofix |
|---------|-------------|------------------|---------|
| [`zcode-agent-valid`](zcode-agent-valid.md) | ZCode subagents must declare a name and a description in frontmatter | error (auto) | - |
| [`zcode-config-valid`](zcode-config-valid.md) | ZCode .zcode/config.json hooks and MCP servers must match ZCode's schema | error (auto) | - |
| [`zcode-hooks-valid`](zcode-hooks-valid.md) | ZCode plugin hooks must use ZCode's events and command/process handlers | error (auto) | - |
| [`zcode-marketplace-json-valid`](zcode-marketplace-json-valid.md) | A ZCode marketplace.json must parse, be named, and list installable local plugins | error (auto) | - |
| [`zcode-plugin-json-valid`](zcode-plugin-json-valid.md) | A .zcode-plugin/plugin.json must be a manifest ZCode's loader accepts | error (auto) | - |
